description:
A Flutter LLM Chat Client. Support Android & iOS & Harmony Next.

A Flutter LLM Chat Client. Support Android & iOS & Harmony Next.
✨ Features
- 🎨 Modern Design - Material You design language with dynamic color theming support (Android 12+).
- 🌙 Dark Mode - Perfectly adapted dark theme to protect your eyes.
- 🌍 Multi-language Support - Supports both English and Chinese interfaces.
- 🖥️ Multi-platform Support - Mobile (Android/iOS/Harmony) and Desktop (Windows/macOS/Linux).
- 🔄 Multi-provider Support - Supports major AI providers like OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic, etc.
- 🤖 Custom Assistants - Create and manage personalized AI assistants.
- 🖼️ Multimodal Input - Supports various formats including images, text documents, PDFs, Word documents, etc.
- 📝 Markdown Rendering - Full support for code highlighting, LaTeX formulas, tables, and more.
- 🎙️ Voice/TTS Providers - Built-in system TTS plus OpenAI / Google Gemini / ElevenLabs voice servers.
- 🛠️ MCP Support - Model Context Protocol tool integration.
- 🧰 Built-in MCP Tools - Includes a built-in MCP Fetch tool.
- 🔍 Web Search - Integrated with multiple search engines (Exa, Tavily, Zhipu, LinkUp, Brave, Bing, Metaso, SearXNG, Ollama, Jina, Perplexity, Bocha).
- 🧩 Prompt Variables - Supports dynamic variables like model name, time, etc.
- 📤 QR Code Sharing - Export and import provider configurations via QR codes.
- 💾 Data Backup - Supports chat history backup and restoration.
- 🌐 Custom Requests - Supports custom HTTP request headers and bodies.
- 🔡 Custom Fonts - Bring your own fonts (system fonts / Google Fonts).
- ⚙️ Android Background Generation - Keep chat generation running in the background (optional setting).
What's Changed
- feat: Add automatic context compaction, with editable summary templates, per-conversation settings, and undo. OpenAI native compaction can be enabled separately.
- feat: Add a fixed context start, so history is sent from a chosen message without rolling truncation by message count.
- feat: Add Standard, Fast, and UltraFast response speed controls in the reasoning picker, saved per conversation and model.
- feat: Add a per-conversation control for image recall, plus local budgets for image size, image count, and request body.
- feat: Detect vision, tools, and thinking support on local Ollama models.
- feat: Let each assistant choose which memory types are always injected in full.
- feat: Add custom model icons, including color and monochrome LobeHub styles.
- feat: Add an optional legacy code block style.
- feat: Quote selected reasoning text into the composer.
- feat: Render Markdown and LaTeX in in-app translation results.
- feat: Add a custom balance query, with its own path, method, headers, and body.
- feat: Add Russian, Korean, and Turkish.
- fix: Limit a browser agent pause to the conversation that started it.
- fix: Recover orphaned Android workspace processes.
- fix: Preserve Codex sessions and Claude thinking across retries and tool continuations, and avoid signing out when a usage check fails.
- fix: Keep follow-up tool requests aligned with the current round after a provider or model change.
- fix: Limit Mermaid rendering memory, and close Windows WebViews before the plugin is torn down.
- fix: Preserve the iOS browser scroll position when the safe area changes.
- fix: Show full model names in lists and settings.
- fix: Keep desktop send shortcuts available in narrow windows.
- fix: Show reasoning activity while the summary is still empty, and restore context usage estimates for chats with images.
- fix: Allow keyboard suggestions on ordinary provider fields while keeping API keys on the secure keyboard.
- fix: Fix several other known bugs and UI issues.
Full Changelog: https://github.com/Chevey339/kelivo/compare/v1.3.4...v1.3.5
